video_title: Doug Christie: Leadership doesn't have an age, early standouts from Kings training camp

quotes.speaker: Doug Christie
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Woodson's coaching style and attention to detail
quotes.excerpt: He is an ultimate professional. His attention to detail is extremely high. He is a coach.
quotes.quote: He is an ultimate professional. His attention to detail is extremely high. He is a coach. He is not an offensive or defensive coach. He is a coach. He is on the defense, but he sees the entire game and I rely on him heavily for his knowledge, mentorship. He has seen so much that it would be really dumb not to listen to the things that he has to say.

quotes.speaker: Doug Christie
quotes.summary_phrase: The importance of execution and mental toughness in drills
quotes.excerpt: It was about execution. It was about mental toughness. It was about not wasting reps.
quotes.quote: It was about execution. It was about mental toughness. It was about not wasting reps. We are not here to waste. We have to take advantage of the opportunity when it presents itself. That means we have to care for our teammate enough to make really good passes where we say on time, on target, and take advantage of the situation when it presents itself.

quotes.speaker: Doug Christie
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMar DeRozan's work ethic and impact on the Kings offense
quotes.excerpt: He is about as hard a worker as you see. Offensively he is special.
quotes.quote: He is about as hard a worker as you see. For us to push him, we are going to push him in a lot of different ways. Obviously defensively, offensively he is special. He can make the shots, he can make the passes. He sees it all. You cannot really speed him up. He plays on the ball, off the ball, so there is a lot of things to be happy about with DeMar DeRozan.

quotes.speaker: Doug Christie
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMar DeRozan's leadership qualities as a new player
quotes.excerpt: Leadership doesn't have an age. He speaks to the team and leadership is just it happens.
quotes.quote: Leadership doesn't have an age. He speaks to the team and leadership is just it happens. And for him it is happening.

quotes.speaker: Doug Christie
quotes.summary_phrase: The importance of community and team commitment in Sacramento
quotes.excerpt: This community is incredible. I love Sacramento. To come back and pour in however that is.
quotes.quote: This community is incredible. I love Sacramento. To come back and pour in however that is, whether it is in the community, for the team, for the team in the community, whatever it is, their willingness to do that is I think the people truly appreciate that.

quotes.speaker: Doug Christie
quotes.summary_phrase: DeAndre Hunter's versatility and impact as a two-way player
quotes.excerpt: DeAndre is a two-way player. He plays defense, three and D, shoots the ball way better.
quotes.quote: DeAndre is a two-way player. He plays defense, three and D, shoots the ball way better than I had anticipated. He has got range, he can shoot it, he is strong, he finishes, athleticism. So he is just another really good piece to the puzzle of what we are trying to accomplish here. So it is an honor and a pleasure to coach him and have him on our team for sure.
